title: W5 Cutover: re-key posts, archive Space Circles, stop creating one per Space, update seeds

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: Space circles become a Community wall; thread plan /mnt/project-files/community-wall/PLAN.md

detail: Re-key verified copies, archive every is_space_primary circle (status archived, slug kept for the redirect), drop the spaces_ensure_space_circle trigger and the auto-enrol triggers, point the-group, wildheart, menswork and free-human seeds at the Space. No post, reply, reaction or member is lost; a count check before and after is the gate. From W3 (2026-11-03): archiving the Space Circles is what removes them from listPublicSpaceCircles (LISTABLE_CIRCLE_STATUS), the Home circles block, Menswork finder and launch rows; check each after the archive.
